info.comment: MAPS_o1_v01 with the mdi_v2 machine-detector interface (A. Ciarma, github.com/aciarma/k4geo branch mdi_v2): MDI_o1_CADBased_v02_collection = v04 CAD beam pipe (new SR masks Pipe_01042026 STLs), LCC 106.2 Z-optics final-focus quads (FFQuads_params_LCC_106-2-2_Z), nonlocal antisolenoid field map (fieldmaps/field_map_main_off_comp_on_01may26_sorted.root), world = Vacuum. Mirrors ALLEGRO_o1_v03_CAD.xml (the geometry of the central ALLEGRO_o1_v03_mdi_v2_CAD production) with the SINGLE swap of the vertex include -> BNL_MAPS 20um VertexComplete_o1_v01. Use with maps_bib_steer.py and the LCC V106.2 pairs. Requires STLs in FCCee/MDI/compact/stl_files/{Pipe_240430,Pipe_01042026}/ and the fieldmap above (all fetched 2026-07-15).
